summary_1line: Drona devastates the Pandava forces in battle, likened to a river of blood, while many warriors attack him and Duryodhana exults at the rout.

image_candidates.scene_text: The battlefield becomes a grotesque river of blood filled with armor waves, severed limbs, elephants like crocodiles, and broken standards like trees.
Drona stands in his golden chariot at the center of the field while dozens of Pandava warriors surround him, loosing arrows from every side.
Yudhishthira turns his chariot and flees as Drona advances through the shattered ranks of soldiers and fallen princes.
